Build Your Own Clone browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive fuzz browse by enclosure pedal Build Your Own Clone Bender Clone Published on April 11, 2006 Build Your Own Clone fuzz pedal Information Build Your Own Clone The SolaSound Tonebender MKII is considered the best by many fuzz connoisseurs. Its huge amounts of thick woolly fuzz, tons of sustain, and controllable feedback even at bedroom levels is everything you could ask for in a fuzz. This is a must have for any Zeppelin fan. The tonebender clone kit comes with a set of 3 selected NOS Philips/Mullard OC75 germanium transistors just like the ones used in the original tonebender.
